title: Unauthenticated host health
description: GET /health and the IPC health op. It carries no device data. The fingerprint is the trust anchor a companion pins when a pairing claim succeeds; reading it here proves nothing on its own. `pairing.mode` is the one word a companion needs before it taps: `open` means a request needs no invitation, `invite` means this host has been locked and the app asks for the 43-character one-shot.

host_id.description: Stable per-installation identity; null before the host identity is installed.

tls_fingerprint_sha256.description: SHA-256 over the served certificate DER, lowercase hex; null when the daemon serves no certificate.

pairing.description: How this host answers a pairing request that carries no invitation. `open` accepts it as pending, `invite` refuses it with pairing_invitation_required. Reading this authorizes nothing: approval is still a local, same-UID decision.

resources.description: PERF-4 §0: what the daemon is holding. Null on a host too old to answer, and any individual reading is null where the platform does not expose it. It is a reading only; nothing acts on it.

condition_shells_total.description: MENU-3: menu-condition shells spawned since start; null without the condition engine (demo).

condition_shells_5m.description: MENU-3: menu-condition shells spawned in the last five minutes; 0 while nothing happens.
